texts.headline: A visual quote builder for your website
texts.subheadline: Your customer picks what they need, sees it in 3D and gets an estimate. You get the request with every detail already filled in.
texts.demosNote: This is a demo to show you the product. It is not set up for your daily work.
how: The visitor configures the product and watches it change in 3D.
The price updates live, as an estimate range that you confirm later.
You get the request by WhatsApp or email, with a printable quote.
forWho: Sign makers and print shops that quote by hand, one message at a time.
Businesses that keep getting vague questions like how much for a sign.
Owners who want the price question answered while the visitor is still on the page.
texts.offerMoreTitle: Built on request, quoted case by case
texts.contactBody: Tell me what you sell and how you charge for it. I reply with a demo built around your own product.
texts.footer: Interactive quote builders for custom products. Built by Lokebox.

setup: Quote tool with your logo, your colors and your texts.
Up to three sign types, with all their options.
3D preview that changes while the visitor picks options.
Price on screen as a range, with your own note.
Leads with the full configuration, by WhatsApp or by form.
Your prices loaded and checked with you.
monthly: Prices kept up to date, up to two updates per month.
Your page online, with your address and its certificate.
Orders saved with the full configuration.
Support with an answer within one working day.
Cancel whenever you want and keep your data.
more: More sign types, or another product family.
Your photos of real jobs in the preview.
Another language on the same page.
